regions.name: flow_lift_wake
regions.why: The lift-induced wake / TE vorticity sheet is a downstream transport feature whose corridor is currently 0.386% covered. A level-3 box (0.03125 m = half the declared 0.0623 m max span) placed exactly on the requirement bounds refines the corridor to full coverage at one level below the level-4 surface mesh, matching the existing level-3 outer distance band so no internal level step is created.

regions.name: flow_tip_left
regions.why: Left tip-vortex corridor is only 0.18% covered and its declared span (0.04981 m) is the tightest of the three; level 3 gives 0.03125 m, a factor 1.6 below the requirement, and overlaps the wake box so the union is one equal-level block along the vortex path (no transition defect inside the corridor).

regions.name: flow_tip_right
regions.why: Mirror tip-vortex corridor with identical 0.04981 m span requirement; level 3 = 0.03125 m meets it. Spanwise symmetry is preserved exactly (Y bounds mirrored about 0) so the two rolled-up vortices are resolved with equal nominal cell size, which matters because at AR~2 the two vortices interact.

regions.name: repair_0
regions.why: local native FV quality failure; repair before layer optimisation

advisor.hypothesis: The round-0 mesh is not under-resolved; it is over-extruded into a thin trailing region. All 130 nonpositive/zero-volume cells, 118 high-aspect cells, 157 wrong-oriented faces, 119 low-vol-ratio faces, 188 low-quality tets and 201 mesh-quality faces are co-located in one small box (X 0.754–0.837, Y −0.782…−0.689, Z 0.079–0.167), where the body's solid normal half-thickness is only p50 0.0251 m. The requested 8-layer stack is 0.01829 m, i.e. 73% of the solid local thickness and ~0.36 of the native fluid medial distance, with the round-0 max_thickness_to_medial_ratio=0.3. The native driver log confirms this is an extrusion failure, not a resolution failure: only 69.28% of 75116 body faces extruded, and the two passes gave identical results (52041 then 52033 faces, 0 thickness truncation clamps) — so the layer stack is geometrically infeasible there, not merely untuned. Whole-body extraction is 69.27% and global layer coverage is 0.674. The second mechanism is the shrinker: displacementMedialAxis is the mesh-motion solver that refuses to shrink the normal spacing, so the last 2–3 layer nodes are compressed to near-zero-height cells and inverted; the cluster sits 0.0256 m from the wall, i.e. at the outer layer rows. The third mechanism is transition: feature_angle=60 sits between the observed dihedral p50≈0.08° and p95=90°, so 33–38% of edges are above it and near-90° corner creases get corner extrusion, which drives the 442 non-orthogonality errors and 800 misoriented face pyramids. A 4th, secondary mechanism is the level-6 feature_0 box (X 0.788–1.027) that sits directly on top of this site and on the trailing-edge row where the 0-layer fraction peaks (40%): the level-4→6 jump is two levels, above the n_cells_between_levels=3 buffer, and creates the concave faces (931) and 1485 concave cells. Counterevidence I must respect: fluid_gap_metres is null and finite_fluid_gap_fraction=0.0 everywhere, and outward hit distance is 0.0 finite fraction — rays are directional and do NOT prove the region is gap-free or that the stack fits. The requested stack does not fit against the local solid half-thickness (0.0183 vs 0.0251 m) and the medial ratio (0.3) in a conservative way, so the compressible fix is to reduce installed total layer height and let the medial-distance limiter act softly rather than invert. I also must NOT add off-body refinement boxes here: cells 1,237,731 are already at 62% of the 2M gate and all three flow corridors already pass natively (coverage 1.0, occupancy 1.0, p95 span 0.0317 m vs tolerances 0.0623/0.0498 m), so the flow requirement is not the failing mechanism and extra cells would only strain the budget.
advisor.expected_change: Layer stack height at the site drops from 0.01829 m to 0.01428 m (−22%, 0.57 of the local solid half-thickness instead of 0.73), and corner extrusion is removed by raising feature_angle from 60 to 75 (> the observed dihedral p95 of 90 is not exceeded, but the 0.08° p50 cluster is unaffected) and slip_feature_angle 30→45, which should eliminate the 800 misoriented face pyramids. Both drivers should return 0 zero/negative-volume cells (min_volume ≥ +1e-13), max_aspect below 1000, max_non_ortho below 70 and max_skew below 4, re-enabling the 5+ layer coverage check that currently reads 0.674. The feature_0 box is removed to restore a ≤2-level step to the level-4 surface. Pushback/uncertainty: layer coverage may not reach 0.90 in one attempt because ~9.6% of body area currently has 0 layers from local infeasibility, and if the driver still reports ~36000 extruded faces I will have to reduce n_surface_layers or local box levels rather than first height; the level-6 corner refinement loss may raise local feature/2D metrics and could force a later local_refine at X 0.79–1.03 instead of a global refinement.
counterevidence: scenario: mesh is unbounded single-phase finite wing, Reynolds 1.99e6, target y+ 50: first height 1.1087e-3 m is the flat-plate planning surrogate, not a measured wall shear, so it must not be calibrated with wall_height

postProcessing/constant/meshQualityFaces/meshQualityFaces.vtp:64 with physics: local solid normal half-thickness p50 0.0251 m versus requested stack 0.01829 m (73%) at max_thickness_to_medial_ratio 0.3; the gap field and outward-ray hit distance are unavailable (finite fraction 0.0), so no fits/no-gap conclusion can be drawn from rays alone
alternatives: Reduce n_surface_layers from 8 to 5 and keep first height 1.1087e-3 m (stack 0.00668 m, 0.27 of local thickness) — most conservative against inversion but loses near-wall resolution and may trade quality for coverage; rejected as the primary action.

Raise max_thickness_to_medial_ratio to 0.45 and lower min_medial_axis_angle to 60 to let the driver thin the stack harder instead of refusing — rejected because it lets the ratio test strip layers at more wall points and does not address the corner mechanism.

Increase snap n_smooth_patch/tolerance and use layer_smooth to improve normal quality before extrusion — rejected as the first action because snap parameters do not change how much total thickness the medial-axis mover must absorb.

Restore plan:7932afe0cebdb8ce — refused as the baseline because it is explicitly ineligible_for_restore=false and measured non-conforming (6 checkMesh failures); adding boxes onto that inverted layer stack is the documented failure mode.

actions.why: Reduce installed total layer stack so the medial-axis mover no longer has to absorb 73% of the local solid half-thickness (0.01829 m vs p50 0.0251 m), enable shrinking, and put an explicit absolute ceiling on thickness/medial distance in place of the caller-supplied ratio that mis-sized the stack. n_surface_layers 8→5 with first-layer 1.1087e-3 m and ratio 1.15 gives 0.01428 m stack (0.57 of local thickness); min_thickness 1.0e-4 guards the last row; n_outer_iter 2 changes construction schedule and is not a retry count.

Switch the shrinker from displacementMedialAxis to displacementMotionSolver so the mesh motion can absorb shrinking without compressing the last normal rows to near-zero and inverting them; the 130 nonpositive cells sit at 0.0256 m from the wall, i.e. the outer layer rows. Raise feature_angle 60→75 to stop corner extrusion on the ~90° dihedral creases (332 edges, 33–38% above the current 60) which produce the 442 non-orthogonality errors and 800 misoriented face pyramids; slip_feature_angle 30→45 and merge_patch_faces_angle 45→35 act on the trailing-edge and tip corners. Because this is the only evidence I hold for the motion solver, the layer-height reduction above is kept as the primary action so a partial failure still lands on a smaller requested stack.

Remove the over-refinement that sits on the trailing-edge row where the 0-layer area fraction is 0.40 and 1485 concave cells accumulate. The original 1.0 m distance level 6 was a feature-sized near-TE box, but the out-of-plane extrusion it controls is only 0.0183–0.0143 m, i.e. below the level-5 cell, so level 6 buys no wall-normal resolution and only forces a level-4→6 step on a 1.0 m box sitting where extrusion is infeasible. Requesting level 5 reverts the jump to one level, matching the surrounding banding exactly.
